PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 1908 (Kurunegala) WHEREAS a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 61 of 02nd November 1979 and as otherwise required by the said section, in respect of the lands situated in the village of Ganangomuwa inthe Hathalispaha korale West in Galgamuwa D.R.O’s Division (Now Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ehetuwewa) Kurunegala District in the North Western Province and described as Lots 1,2,3,4,6,7,9,10, 11 and 12 in Block Survey Preliminary Plan No. 3856 (North West) (Vide Settlement Notice No. 4864 (Kurunegala): And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance : I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the said lands or portion thereof be settled in the Schedule to this order .
